findings.locator: surveys/weekly/2026-W42/main.tex Section 7 + Table T7 (B54 prose: "79件中7位")
findings.reason: Worker L02 confirms the Vals anchor (19.17%, $0.15/test, LegalBench 86.23%) but documents live-source denominator drift: Updates prose pins #7 of 79 while header/table now show #7 of 81 as the leaderboard grew. The TeX pins the 79 snapshot without naming the drift, so a reader comparing against the live page will see a denominator mismatch.
findings.proposed_normalization: Add a parenthetical snapshot marker in a future revision (e.g. window-snapshot denominator) or a one-line disclosed-limitation note; do not silently change the number without re-audit.

findings.locator: surveys/weekly/2026-W42/main.tex Section 7 (B54 prose, twice: lead paragraph and design paragraph)
findings.reason: Worker L02 fetch finds current card latency "37 min 25 s" and no 72-min field in the fetched excerpt; the 72-min figure is either source drift or a different timing field (total vs per-test) that cannot be re-fetched for the window. The TeX repeats 72 min twice as a measurement condition, so the field-level provenance is weaker than the ranking anchor.
findings.proposed_normalization: Qualify the figure as window-state reported value with disclosed limitation, or drop the minute figure to price-only if the field cannot be sourced; no silent revision.

findings.locator: surveys/weekly/2026-W42/main.tex Section 7 (B57 prose: "10月16日の今週の出来事", "10月16日のX投稿は告知")
findings.reason: Worker L02 confirms repo existence, Apache-2.0 apportionment, and June-vs-October split, but the fetched README shows month granularity ([2026-10]) only with no Oct-16 commit/release timestamp in the excerpt. The TeX asserts day precision twice; table T7 itself says month-granularity, creating a prose/table precision asymmetry. No separate ASPIRE X-post bib key exists, so the X sentence is correctly announcement-discipline prose, not a dated citation.
findings.proposed_normalization: Soften prose day-precision to month-anchored wording consistent with Table T7, or retain with explicit disclosed-limitation note; do not invent a commit timestamp.
